statements.statement: The patient presents with paroxysmal palpitations and episodic lightheadedness
There is concern for recurrent supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation
The patient has a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The service is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is clinically necessary to evaluate cardiac rhythm in this context
